_meta.source: Template IDs extracted via documentServices API

notes.cartBadge: Template cart (shoppingCartIcon1) is a TPAWidget — has built-in badge. Our code references #cartBadge separately. May need to use the TPAWidget's API instead or add a Text element in editor.
notes.footerEmailInput_footerEmailSubmit: Template uses form2 (TPAWidget newsletter form), not separate input+button. Our FooterSection.js references #footerEmailInput and #footerEmailSubmit individually. Options: (a) add separate input+button elements alongside form2, or (b) rewrite FooterSection.js to use form2's TPAWidget API.
notes.footerPhone_Address_Hours: Template has a single text block (text18) for all contact info. Our code references #footerPhone, #footerAddress, #footerHours separately. Options: (a) split text18 into 3 Text elements in editor, or (b) rewrite FooterSection.js to set all info in text18.
notes.socialLinks: Template footer has social links but they're inside box32 as part of the nav structure — not individually nicknamed. May need to add individual IDs in editor for #socialFacebook, #socialInstagram, #socialPinterest.
notes.overlays_phase2: exitIntentPopup, promoLightbox, newsletterModal, installBanner, sideCartPanel, headerShippingBar — all GAP elements not in template. Defer to Phase 2 or add as hidden elements in editor.
notes.a11yLiveRegion: GAP — needs hidden Text element added in editor
notes.businessSchemaHtml: GAP — needs hidden HtmlComponent added in editor
notes.websiteSchemaHtml: GAP — needs hidden HtmlComponent added in editor
